descriptions.d24i_setting_substitute_80103a5c: Read the text setting named by item +44 (0x800fc2b0), making and dropping a copy of the name if it is absent; replace every occurrence of the pattern in item +52 with the text of item +56 by rebuilding and sharing a local string; write the result to the setting named by item +48 (0x800fc550), making and dropping a copy of that name if the write fails.
